documents.title: FastAPI App
documents.description: All Brain logic. 40+ endpoints on :9011 — the 12 MCP-backed memory tools plus /api/status, agents, heartbeats, war room, dispatch, compliance, poller, distiller, inbox. CORS *, project_id normalization + fuzzy resolution. ~1,770 LOC.

documents.title: MCP Server
documents.description: stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 bridge exposing 12 tools (qi_get_context, qi_log_decision, ...). ~150 LOC of forwarders to the FastAPI endpoints. Registered globally in claude.json.

documents.title: Bootstrap
documents.description: Idempotent 10-step init (create_db, seed agents/providers/config/projects, init Chroma, ingest docs + summaries, seed decisions, log bootstrap). Tracked in bootstrap_log; --reset re-runs all.

documents.title: DB Connection Helper
documents.description: open_brain_db() — the single WAL-mode connection factory (busy_timeout 5000, foreign_keys ON, Row factory). DB_PATH = C:\QIH\data\qi_brain.db. init_db() applies schema.sql per-statement.

documents.title: Database Schema
documents.description: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for the core tables (agents, llm_providers, brain_config, projects, project_state, decisions, features, feature_evaluations, evaluation_overrides, session_log, bootstrap_log) + indexes + seed agents. Per Plan 001 + Supplement A.

documents.title: ChromaDB Memory Store
documents.description: MemoryStore — PersistentClient at qi_memory/, 4 cosine collections (qi_decisions/qi_features/qi_sessions/qi_docs), add_decision/feature/session/doc upserts, search() returns id/document/metadata/distance, collection_counts().

documents.title: Provider Factory + Adapters
documents.description: Config-driven providers from llm_providers. ProviderFactory.from_db()/get_by_role(); BrainProvider ABC; OllamaProvider (/api/generate, strips <think>); NomicEmbedProvider (768-dim, /api/embeddings, embed-only).

documents.title: Background Poller
documents.description: Daemon thread: per-project state.json + git log --since, file inbox ingest. Config in brain_config (poll_interval_s, poll_min_file_age_s, poll_enabled). start_poller/stop_poller/run_poll_cycle.

documents.title: Feature Propagation Engine
documents.description: propagate_feature()/propagate_all_pending(): local qwen3:8b judges cross-project relevance with last-5-eval history; strict JSON contract + 1 retry; writes feature_evaluations + marks propagated.

documents.title: Distiller
documents.description: LLM summarization of raw inbox notes into structured records (VALID_REASONS). Backs POST /api/distill + /api/distill/history.

documents.title: Documentation Harvester
documents.description: Discovers/classifies every ecosystem .md/.docx into the docs table (921), derives typed edges into doc_relationships (2,203), optional embed into qi_docs. Self-ensures tables; prune() drops vanished files.

documents.title: SQL Migrations
documents.description: Dated idempotent migrations adding heartbeats, the auto-apply/dispatch pipeline, the doc index + knowledge graph, and War Room chat. Applied via run_migration.py.

documents.title: Backup Task
documents.description: Scheduled SQLite backup of qi_brain.db (brain_config backup_enabled=true, retain 30).

documents.title: First Brain Call + Helpers
documents.description: Operational helpers: smoke a first MCP call, Ollama availability checks, register the 7 hive agents, push the Brain entry into qi_registry.json.

documents.title: Smoke Test
documents.description: Pytest smoke check of the Brain API surface; part of the ecosystem SMOKE_TARGETS suite (driven from qi_registry.json).

documents.title: Brain Architecture Plan 001
documents.description: The founding plan: the dual-store design, the 12-tool contract, and Supplement A implementation rules (I-01 thin MCP, I-02 WAL, I-08 supersede, I-14 override).

documents.title: Brain Build Complete
documents.description: Build-completion summary for the initial Brain (DB + Chroma + MCP + bootstrap).

documents.title: Documentation Brain Summary
documents.description: Session summary for the Documentation Brain work — doc_harvester, the doc index migration, and the hive-librarian agent.

documents.title: One-Brain Next Session
documents.description: Hand-off prompt consolidating the Brain into the single ecosystem nervous system.

documents.title: QI Ecosystem Registry (qi_brain)
documents.description: Brain registry entry: id qi_brain, path C:\QIH\engine\brain, tier backbone, family orchestration, api port 9011 (block 9000-9099), mcp stdio, service QI_BrainAPI, dependents = all projects via MCP, the 12 mcp_tools.

documents.title: QI Service Registry (QI_BrainAPI)
documents.description: Canonical NSSM entry: QI_BrainAPI, binary python.exe, params api.py, AppDirectory C:\QIH, log qi_brain_api.log. Symptom->service->log table: 'Brain API (:9011) down -> nssm status QI_BrainAPI'.

documents.title: Documentation Brain (memory)
documents.description: Claude's persistent memory note on the doc index + knowledge graph, the ChromaDB multi-process caveat, and the /api/admin/reload_memory fix.

documents.title: QI Architecture Principles (Law 6)
documents.description: The Six Laws governing all QI projects; Law 6 (Owner Override) is the basis for the Brain's evaluation_overrides + qi_override_evaluation.
